description: This file is a BitBake recipe (with .inc extension) for building and installing the Lemon Parser Generator. It defines variables for source URLs, build steps, and installation procedures specific to Lemon within a build environment.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Builds the lemon tool by compiling lemon.c into lemon.o and linking it into the executable 'lemon'.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the lemon binary and its man page, creating necessary directories and setting permissions.
